method: Primary-agent source review against the user coding conventions and native UI request; not a new independent code-review run.
standards: No new dependencies, test-only seams, fixed page colors or custom bar layers. Descriptive names, existing real-store commands, narrow checks.
spec: Global catalog actions use source IDs and say everywhere; contextual List/Itinerary commands are unchanged. Existing selection/draft guards remain intact. Q97 native adoption and final release gates remain open.
